name.value: Kootenay Gallery of Art, History & Science

description.value: The Kootenay Gallery of Art, History and Science is a non-profit public art gallery in Castlegar serving the entire West Kootenay Region, one of 28 original rural exhibition centres established in the 1970s to bring regional, national, and international art to BC's interior communities. It mounts rotating exhibitions, offers hands-on workshops, and maintains a gift shop, making it a cultural anchor for the region. Situated next to the Doukhobor Discovery Centre and across from the Castlegar Airport, it offers a compelling cultural detour for cyclists exploring the Kootenays.
